Specification: This module specifies a one-bit mutual exclusion protocol for N processes, originally written in PlusCal and translated into TLA+. Each process repeatedly cycles through noncritical section, entry, critical section, and exit, using a shared boolean flag array and a local index j to scan other processes and wait when contention is detected. The specification includes the initial state, per-process actions, a global Next action, and the temporal specification Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars.
IfThenElse: IF j[self] /= self THEN /\ IF flag[j[self]] THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter3"] /\ j' = j ELSE /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = j[self] + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter2"] ELSE /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = self + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter5"]
IF flag[j[self]] THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter3"] /\ j' = j ELSE /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = j[self] + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter2"]
IF j[self] < N THEN /\ ~flag[j[self]] /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = j[self] + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter5"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"] /\ j' = j
